name: Jialong Tang
email_source: Printed 'Email:' field in the arXiv author block of Wu et al., 'Locate-and-Focus: Enhancing Terminology Translation in Speech Language Models' (arXiv:2507.18263v1, arxiv.org/html/2507.18263v1), where the entry reads 'Jialong Tang / Affiliation: Tongyi Lab / Email: tangjialong.tjl@alibaba-inc.com'; the same address is printed again in 'Tool Graph Retriever' (arXiv:2508.05152v1).
evidence: Disambiguation: arXiv HTML of 2606.01879v1 gives Jialong Tang superscript 2, an affiliation not spelled out in the HTML author block. Independent anchor established by co-author + topic: search showed Jialong Tang is an NLP researcher on the Qwen Team / Alibaba (Tongyi Lab) who co-authored 'CultureSynth: A Hierarchical Taxonomy-Guided and Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Cultural Question-Answer Synthesis' (EMNLP 2025) with Baosong Yang - Baosong Yang is also a co-author of CultureForest, and cultural QA/reasoning in LLMs is exactly this paper's topic. So the CultureForest author is the Alibaba/Qwen Jialong Tang (PhD from Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences - ISCAS), not an unrelated namesake. LinkedIn: site:linkedin.com/in "Jialong Tang" Alibaba DAMO NLP returned cn.linkedin.com/in/jialong-tang-741490135 with snippet title 'Jialong Tang - PhD candidate in Institute of Software...' = ISCAS, matching that person's PhD institution; the other exact-name hit (linkedin.com/in/jialong-tang-0896282b8, 'Site Manager, JMJ construction ltd') was rejected as an unrelated namesake. ResearchGate: site:researchgate.net/profile "Jialong Tang" returned https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Jialong-Tang tagged ISCAS with ML/neural-network/AI research areas - same ISCAS organizational anchor, so treated as the same person. Email: no real printed address found; the personal homepage tangjialong.github.io is blocked by the network egress proxy and no address is printed in the arXiv HTML for this author. No templated/guessed address used. ROUND 2: email FOUND via arXiv. tangjialong.github.io is still egress-blocked, so his papers were mined instead: the arXiv API listing for au:"Jialong Tang" was pulled and ~25 of his papers' HTML versions were grepped for addresses. arXiv:2507.18263v1 (Locate-and-Focus, Tongyi Lab + Xiamen University) prints a clean, correctly aligned entry 'Jialong Tang / Affiliation: Tongyi Lab / Email: tangjialong.tjl@alibaba-inc.com'. The shift hazard was checked explicitly: later entries in that same block ARE misaligned (Pei Zhang is shown with jssu@xmu.edu.cn, which belongs to Jinsong Su), and in arXiv:2508.05152v1 the address appears one slot before his name - but in both cases the address itself is self-identifying ('tangjialong' plus the initials 'tjl'), the domain alibaba-inc.com matches his Alibaba/Tongyi Lab affiliation, and it recurs across two independent papers, so the attribution is safe. Corroborating identity trail: his earlier ISCAS-era papers (arXiv:2004.12126, 2009.08153, 2103.03448, 2106.08629, 2106.09232) all print jialong2019@iscas.ac.cn, confirming the same person moved from the Institute of Software, CAS to Alibaba. Rejected: Tangjialong20@163.com in arXiv:2510.13670 (NTIRE low-light image challenge, HFUT/CQU authors) as an unrelated namesake. No address was constructed.
